data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Shai means 'given by God'. This name appears in the Bible in various contexts, such as a son of Hezron in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3:33), and a prophet who delivered an oracle from the Lord (Isaiah 24:2). In the spiritual realm, Shai represents the divine gift of life and guidance.
